$comment: NPC Contact's contacts by the cache's npc_contact contact_id (dbtable 130, read by plugins/interface/NpcContact.plugin.js; docs/npc-contact.md). npc is the NPC gameval whose conversation the contact opens. With no variant it is the NPC's own Talk-to, as rsprox captures show for the Slayer masters (1698, 4056, 1146: Turael, Mazchna, Duradel, Nieve answer "'Ello, and what are you after then?"). variant (optional) names a transcript variant to play instead; none is used yet, because the Wiki astral-contact variants (Honest Jimmy, Murphy, Cyrisus) branch on conditions and cycled menus nothing answers (docs/npc-contact.md).
